3ec8a4f783d75835.description: About Ferring Pharmaceuticals Ferring Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to advancing scientific understanding in reproductive and women’s health, gastroenterology, and urology. The company focuses on developing solutions that help individuals build families and improve their lives globally. This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Role Summary The Medical Representative is responsible for promoting Ferring products to healthcare professionals in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves executing marketing strategies, maintaining stakeholder relationships, and gathering market intelligence. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Promote Ferring products to healthcare professionals in accordance with established marketing strategies, frequency, and impact targets. Build and maintain professional relationships with healthcare professionals and other relevant stakeholders. Participate in local, regional, and international scientific congresses as determined by the company. Classify doctors and stakeholders based on segmentation and targeting criteria, proposing additions, changes, or removals from existing files. Track prescription habits, assess product perception, verify prescription potential, and evaluate influence among other doctors. 3e033f85adcd67b1.description: About KBR and the Role KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) delivers comprehensive solutions across the entire asset lifecycle, encompassing licensed process technologies, advisory services, technical expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design capabilities, and smart solutions for optimizing assets. KBR is seeking a Reliability Engineer to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern region. This is a full-time position focused on coordinating and executing responsibilities related to establishing and governing the Total Reliability Program Framework within a refinery setting. Key Responsibilities Develop the framework and methodology for criticality assessment and reliability improvement programs for refinery assets. Lead and conduct Asset Criticality Analysis for all refinery assets, including data collection, workshop facilitation, report compilation, and SAP data population. Champion the implementation of various reliability methodologies across all asset types by establishing programs to sustain operational excellence. Serve as the primary contact for reliability culture development in projects and operating facilities, providing technical guidance to safeguard asset reliability throughout its lifecycle. Administer and execute Asset Lifecycle management procedures, including Asset criticality ranking, SAP Taxonomy, Asset Operating Limits (IOW), maintenance development, Master data developments in SAP, Bill of Materials (BOM) in SAP, and active SAP-PMs implementation and effectiveness. Initiate and conduct studies for facility and operational asset improvements, offering specialized technical service and acting as a consultant on complex engineering problems. Integrate lessons learned from benchmarks and safety cases, providing recommendations to ensure continuous assurance for Safety-Critical Equipment within the Total Reliability program. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to analyze integrity and performance, suggesting methods for preventing chronic failures, and supporting the review of Total Reliability program KPIs. Report to the Project Manager, leading the Reliability section to deliver periodic outcomes and progress reports. Work closely with the project execution team to ensure commitment to the Reliability Transformation Program. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated expertise in reliability engineering principles and methodologies. Proficiency in SAP modules related to asset management and maintenance (*, SAP-PM). Work Environment This role is based in Al Jubail, Eastern, and operates on a full-time basis. The Reliability Engineer will work within a refinery environment, collaborating with various plant-wide and multidisciplinary teams to achieve reliability objectives. About KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) KBR STS is committed to providing holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle, leveraging world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, and energy transition solutions.

3e1e146f6aa8d188.description: About the Role El-Ajou Group Trading is seeking an AV Site Supervisor to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supervising and coordinating on-site Audio Visual (AV) installation, service delivery, and technician teams. The supervisor will act as the primary on-site point of contact for technical execution and client coordination, ensuring work adheres to quality, safety, and SLA standards, while also providing hands-on support for complex AV troubleshooting, installation, and commissioning. Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate daily activities of AV technicians and installation teams on assigned sites and projects. Plan and allocate manpower, tools, and materials to meet project and service schedules. Serve as the primary on-site contact for clients, project managers, and consultants during installation, commissioning, and service visits. Review and approve technicians' work quality, installation standards, and documentation before customer handover. Monitor site progress against timelines and escalate delays, risks, or resource gaps to management. Enforce company safety, quality, and technical standards on site, including conducting toolbox talks and routine safety checks. Mentor, train, and evaluate the performance of AV technicians, providing on-the-job coaching. Coordinate with Sales, Project Management, and Supply Chain to resolve site-level material, access, or scheduling issues. Prepare and submit site progress reports, punch lists, and completion/handover documentation. Act as the first-level escalation point for on-site technical issues before engaging OEM/manufacturer support. Technical Delivery Install, configure, test, commission, and maintain AV systems and equipment. Troubleshoot and repair projectors, professional displays, LED/LCD screens, video walls, interactive displays, audio systems, microphones, speakers, amplifiers, control systems, and conferencing solutions. Support meeting rooms, boardrooms, classrooms, auditoriums, and digital signage solutions. Configure and troubleshoot signal distribution and connectivity, including HDMI, HDBaseT, IP-based AV, audio/video switching, and network-connected AV devices. Provide technical support for video conferencing and collaboration systems. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance according to service requirements and SLAs. Conduct site surveys and support preparation of technical requirements and solution designs. Coordinate with manufacturers/OEM technical support for complex escalations. Maintain accurate records of installed equipment, serial numbers, configurations, and service history. Provide customer training and basic operational guidance after installation. Maintain high levels of first-fix performance, response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction across the site team. Qualifications and Experience Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, IT, Telecommunications, Audio Visual Technology, or a related discipline. Minimum of 5–8 years of hands-on AV technical experience, including at least 1–2 years in a site supervisory, team lead, or lead technician role. Proven experience supervising AV installation/service teams on multi-site or project-based work. Strong experience in AV installation, troubleshooting, and maintenance. Good understanding of AV networking, signal flow, cabling, audio/video protocols, and control systems. Experience with major professional AV brands is preferred. OEM or industry AV certifications are an advantage. Good English communication, reporting, and technical documentation skills. Valid Saudi driving license is preferred for multi-site travel. The role involves leading a team of AV technicians and coordinating with multiple stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery and service standards.

3ece3e63a98848b7.description: Job Summary Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Director of Sales & Marketing A for its location in Makkah. This full-time role is responsible for overseeing the hotel's sales department, particularly for properties with over 300 rooms during peak booking periods and significant local food and beverage revenue. The Director will manage both reactive and proactive sales efforts, provide daily leadership to the sales team, and ensure the achievement of sales targets, booking goals, and overall hotel revenue. Core Responsibilities Implement brand service strategies and initiatives across all aspects of the sales process, focusing on building value-based, long-term customer relationships to meet hotel sales objectives. Evaluate the hotel's engagement across various sales channels (*, regional sales, sales office group sales, electronic channels) and establish strong working relationships to proactively position and promote the hotel. Manage the marketing budget to develop hotel-specific activities, promotions, and collateral that drive revenue and achieve hotel goals. Collaborate with regional marketing communications to advance regional and national promotional activities. Develop and implement a hotel-wide strategy to deliver products and services that meet or exceed the needs and expectations of target customers and hotel employees, ensuring a return on investment for owners and Marriott International. Review STAR reports and competitive shopping reports, utilizing other resources to maintain awareness of the hotel's market position. Research competitor sales team strategies to identify opportunities for increasing occupancy, RevPAR, and market share. Participate in sales strategy meetings and provide input on weekly and overall sales strategies. Propose innovative marketing concepts and deployment strategies to continuously increase market share. Evaluate and support regional sales and sales office group sales engagement and client deployment. Act as the sales liaison for the General Manager, hotel leadership team, group sales, and regional sales executives. Serve as the sales liaison and advocate for clients, and the hotel's authorized signatory for sales processes and contracts. Participate in sales calls with sales and marketing team members to secure new business and/or close existing business. Identify public relations opportunities and coordinate activities to reinforce the overall marketing communications strategy. Support the General Manager by coordinating crisis communications. Execute and support Marriott customer service standards and hotel brand standards. Execute and support the operational aspects of business booked (*, generating proposals, writing contracts, customer correspondence). Participate in and practice brand's daily service basics (*, MHR Service Communities Daily Basics, RHR Intuitive Service Basics, Courtyard, SpringHill Suites, Fairfield Inn Daily Basics, Residence Inn Daily Huddle, or TownePlace Suites Morning Meeting). Ensure a seamless transition from sales to operations and back to sales, consistently delivering a high level of service. Perform other assigned duties as needed to meet business demands. Relationship Management Build strong partner relationships with local organizations to enhance brand/product awareness. Establish and manage relationships with key internal stakeholders. Build strong community and public relations by ensuring hotel participation in local, regional, and national trade shows and client events. Demonstrate exemplary customer service by assisting customers and monitoring their satisfaction before and during their programs/events to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty. Serve customers by understanding their needs and recommending features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, building relationships and loyalty to Marriott. Understand the hotel's primary target customer and service expectations; serve them by understanding their business, business issues, and concerns, and providing better business solutions before and during their programs/events. Leadership and Development Set sales goals and strategies, ensuring alignment with brand business strategies. Execute sales strategies to achieve personal and team booking goals. Guide revenue generation leaders in developing effective revenue strategies and setting aggressive goals that drive hotel financial performance. Verify that the sales team understands and utilizes the Marriott International (MI) demand engines. Collaborate with Human Resources, Engineering, and Loss Prevention to monitor compliance with local, state, and federal laws and/or union requirements. Partner with Human Resources to attract, develop, and retain appropriate talent to support the market's strategic priorities. Establish effective structures, processes, work, and performance management systems. Utilize the Leadership Performance Process (LPP) to set goals and expectations for direct reports; administer performance and rewards; address performance issues, and hold employees accountable for successful performance. Forecast talent needs with Human Resources (HR) and manage talent acquisition strategies to minimize lost time due to attrition. Maintain a roster of top sales performers from competitors and execute recruiting and hiring plans with HR. Provide support for tools and training resources to guide sales associates in securing food and beverage solutions. Support leadership development and workforce planning priorities by assessing, selecting, retaining, and developing diverse, high-caliber talent who can lead the company today and strengthen the leadership bench for the future; continuously upgrade the business skills of sales and marketing talent; partner with HR to forecast future talent needs based on business growth plans. Identify, train, and mentor team sales associates; utilize all available on-the-job training tools for employees. Transfer functional knowledge and foster team selling skills in other professional managers. Experience and Qualifications Minimum of 5-10 years of experience in sales and marketing, preferably within the hospitality industry. Demonstrated ability to lead a sales team and achieve revenue targets. Strong understanding of market trends and competitive landscapes. Experience in managing budgets and developing promotional activities. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, at Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts. The role involves working within a dynamic hotel environment, collaborating with various departments and external partners to achieve sales and marketing objectives.

3ef14316884d9ff4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة وليد محمد غزاوي عن صيدلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان صرف الأدوية بدقة وتقديم الإرشاد اللازم للمرضى، مع الالتزام بالمعايير الصيدلانية وإجراءات السلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مواصفات وتركيبات الأدوية والعقاقير والمواد الصيدلانية، وتحضيرها وصرفها وفقاً للوصفات الطبية. تحديد الآثار الجانبية المحتملة لاستخدام الأدوية وتأثيراتها على الإنسان. تقييم احتياجات الصيدلية من الأدوية والعلاجات، وتحديد أنواعها وكمياتها ومواصفاتها. إعداد وتدقيق طلبات الشراء، ومتابعة توفير الأدوية واستلامها وتخزينها حسب سجلات الموجودات والمعايير الصيدلانية. مراجعة الوصفات الطبية وتجهيز الدواء قبل صرفه، وتقديم الإرشاد للمريض حول طريقة الاستعمال والآثار الجانبية المحتملة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال الصيدلة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالصيدلة وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الصيدلة. القدرة على فهم وتحليل الوصفات الطبية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بمواصفات وتركيبات الأدوية وآثارها. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم الإرشاد للمرضى. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية والصيدلانية. القدرة على تنظيم العمل وإدارة المخزون بفعالية. الرغبة في التعلم المستمر ومواكبة التطورات في المجال. بيئة العمل يعمل الصيدلي بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة وليد محمد غزاوي في مدينة مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة لضمان جودة الخدمات الصيدلانية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الموقع: مكة المكرمة. الراتب: غير معلن.

3e624fa8f389adf7.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن مجموعة بن لادن السعودية عن حاجتها لتوظيف كاتب حفظ ملفات للعمل بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تنظيم وإدارة الوثائق والسجلات بكفاءة، مما يضمن سهولة الوصول إليها والاحتفاظ بها بشكل آمن ومنظم. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية فحص وتصنيف الكتب والمراسلات والإيصالات والفواتير والرسوم والبيانات وغيرها من الأوراق والوثائق المراد حفظها، وفرزها بحسب النوع والطبيعة. تصنيف المكاتبات والمراسلات وفقاً للموضوع أو الحروف الهجائية أو أي نظام تصنيف آخر معتمد. وضع المواد المراد حفظها في الملفات المخصصة لها بحسب التصنيف المعتمد، وترتيب الملفات على الرفوف أو داخل الدواليب بشكل منهجي. استخراج الوثائق المحفوظة وتحويلها إلى الجهات المعنية عند الطلب، مع الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المتبعة. الاحتفاظ بفهارس أو بطاقات فهرسة الملفات بطريقة منظمة، والمحافظة على سلامتها ودقتها لضمان سهولة البحث والاسترجاع. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال حفظ الملفات أو إدارة الوثائق. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية عالية ودقة في العمل. القدرة على اتباع أنظمة التصنيف والإجراءات المحددة. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل لضمان صحة ودقة حفظ الوثائق. مهارات تواصل جيدة للتعامل مع طلبات استخراج الوثائق. بيئة العمل سيعمل كاتب حفظ الملفات ضمن فريق في مجموعة بن لادن السعودية، في بيئة عمل منظمة تتطلب الالتزام بالدقة والسرية في التعامل مع الوثائق. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية التوظيف.

3ecd225b03f47bd3.description: About Almosafer Almosafer Travel & Tourism Co. is a leading travel company in Saudi Arabia, serving millions across the travel and tourism sector. The company aims to provide seamless, personal, and purposeful travel experiences through its diverse platforms and services. Almosafer is committed to being a leader in travel services, fostering connections, and setting benchmarks for excellence in the Kingdom and beyond. Role Overview: Officer - CT Branch Sales This full-time role, based in Unayzah, is responsible for assisting customers in identifying suitable holiday products and providing information on travel itineraries. The Officer will inspire customer thinking and help them select appropriate holiday packages. This position requires 0-3 years of experience and focuses on achieving individual sales targets and enhancing the overall customer experience. Key Responsibilities Provide leisure travel assistance for clients, including air, hotel, resort, cruise, restaurant, tours, and sightseeing. Stay updated on products and services through ongoing research using the internet, sales representatives, industry publications, and other media. Ensure sales targets are achieved by maintaining a high customer conversion rate. Act as the first point of contact for walk-in customers to enhance their experience. Advise customers on travel insurance, visas, vaccinations, and other related aspects of holiday packages or travel. Resolve conflicts and issues, follow up with customers about travel plans, and adjust as needed. Receive and process customer feedback on service quality and identify areas for improvement. Identify and understand customer needs to customize packages, ensuring high satisfaction and retention. Maintain a high level of competency, initiative, confidentiality, and professional demeanor. Gather required documents/information for processing requests such as visas and IDLs, and liaise with the Service Coordinator for prompt responses. Maintain a database of regular customer bookings, meal, and seat preferences, offering personalized services when required. Adhere to service level targets and coordinate with other departments to meet client service expectations. Stay fully informed of all airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and industry requirements, applying this information accurately when making travel arrangements. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will have 0-3 years of experience in a relevant field. This role requires individuals who are customer-focused, possess strong communication skills, and are dedicated to achieving sales objectives while maintaining high service standards. Working at Almosafer At Almosafer, teams operate with purpose, clarity, and a commitment to quality. Employees contribute to a larger mission, whether building platforms, supporting travelers, or shaping strategy. The company values accountability, trust, and collaboration, providing a structured environment for meaningful contributions from day one. Almosafer offers a workplace where ideas can create impact, with ongoing learning and development opportunities, and recognition for achievements. Location This position is based in Unayzah, Saudi Arabia.

3e15e1a7434bb412.description: About the Role BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is seeking an Egress Senior Supervisor to join their team in Taif. This full-time role is integral to supporting the Salam Project, ensuring its success against contracted Operational Readiness (OR) and Key Performance Measurements (KPM) for Maintenance Support Services. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience and offers a competitive salary. Company Context BAE Systems operates as the UK Government’s nominated Prime Contractor, providing equipment, support, and training to Saudi Arabia under Government-to-Government arrangements. The company is responsible for the maintenance of Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF) aircraft and the training of RSAF and Royal Saudi Naval Force personnel. BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is committed to supporting the Saudi Arabian National Agenda, including Saudisation and the development of Saudi National capabilities through partnerships and industrialisation. Key Responsibilities Report to the Primary Line Manager with direct access to a Secondary Line Manager for independent issue resolution within the Egress Shop maintenance environment. Review maintenance practices, challenge existing methods, and identify potential improvements within the organisation. Identify and report any malpractice affecting the airworthiness or safety of assigned components or personnel to the Senior Maintenance Manager. Manage and ensure the availability of necessary manpower and facilities resources in accordance with company policies and contractual obligations. Oversee the development reports for all direct and indirect line management personnel within the area of responsibility. Provide consolidation and counterpart development activities for RSAF and BAE Systems personnel. Ensure all tasks are completed within designated timeframes to support Forward Maintenance and SMU activities. Manage the operational readiness of shop equipment, including necessary calibrations, correct tooling, and approved data. Report deficiencies in approved data using appropriate media. Report and monitor any damage or deficiencies to equipment and infrastructure using specified media (*, IDR, MDR, CAR, SORT, 1400-61). Maintain anti-FOD surveillance and report potential hazards, enhanced by regular oversight checks of the shop and its components. Ensure all maintenance tasks meet the highest quality standards, including accurate recording on the airworthiness tool (ESS) for work carried out, test results, consumables, and POL. Support knowledge transfer and skill development among team members, maintaining training records and logs. Manage the TTP131 spreadsheet to reflect forecasted planning and highlight any deficiencies or delivery issues with consumables and PPE. Ensure effective communication and coordination with maintenance teams, engineering departments, and management. Confirm that all equipment entering the Egress shop is free from explosives. Maintain competency currency for Martin Baker seat and canopy component authorisations. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to manage maintenance operations and ensure compliance with airworthiness and safety standards. Proficiency in identifying and implementing process improvements. Experience in managing manpower and facility resources. Strong communication and coordination skills. Competency in maintaining authorisations for Martin Baker seat and canopy components. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Taif, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic environment focused on supporting critical maintenance operations for the Royal Saudi Air Force. The role involves working closely with both BAE Systems and RSAF personnel, contributing to national development initiatives. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this role.

3e6c27a93a4578f1.description: About Entaj Entaj is seeking an Electrical Supervisor to join its team in Al Kharj, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for maintaining the safety, reliability, and optimal performance of electrical systems within a poultry processing facility. Role Overview The Electrical Supervisor will oversee all electrical maintenance operations across the facility. This includes managing electrical systems for production lines, utilities such as refrigeration and boilers, the Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP), Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems, and external areas. The primary focus is to maximize equipment availability, minimize operational downtime, ensure compliance with electrical safety standards, and drive continuous improvement in reliability, energy efficiency, and maintenance cost optimization. Key Responsibilities Supervise the operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of LV/MV electrical systems, Motor Control Centers (MCCs), Main Distribution Boards (MDBs), transformers, generators, motors, Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), and electrical panels. Plan and ensure the effective execution of preventive and corrective maintenance activities. Diagnose electrical faults, resolve equipment breakdowns, and minimize production downtime. Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major and recurring electrical failures and implement corrective actions. Ensure compliance with electrical safety procedures, including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), Permit to Work (PTW), and company standards. Support electrical projects, equipment modifications, commissioning, and continuous improvement initiatives. Monitor critical electrical equipment, spare parts availability, and maintenance requirements. Coordinate with Production, Utilities, HSE, Projects, and external contractors to ensure efficient maintenance operations. Drive electrical reliability, energy efficiency, and maintenance cost-reduction initiatives. Utilize SAP PM for maintenance planning, work orders, and maintenance performance tracking. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Kharj, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a poultry processing facility. The role requires active involvement in overseeing electrical systems across various operational areas, including production lines, utility systems, and external infrastructure. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this Electrical Supervisor position with Entaj.

3ec3265a122c131c.description: تعلن الشركة عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى مهندس معماري ، يتولى مسؤولية إعداد وتطوير التصاميم المعمارية للمشاريع، وتحويل متطلبات المشروع إلى مخططات وتصاميم تجمع بين الجوانب الجمالية والوظيفية، مع التأكد من توافقها مع احتياجات المشروع واشتراطات البناء والمواصفات الفنية المعتمدة. كما يتولى متابعة الأعمال المعمارية والتنسيق مع الفرق الهندسية المختلفة لضمان تنفيذ التصاميم وفقاً للمخططات المعتمدة ومعايير الجودة المطلوبة. المهام والمسؤوليات: إعداد وتطوير التصاميم والمخططات المعمارية للمشاريع وفقاً لمتطلبات العمل. إعداد ومراجعة الرسومات والمخططات المعمارية والتأكد من دقتها ومطابقتها للمواصفات المعتمدة. مراعاة الجوانب الجمالية والوظيفية في التصميم وتحقيق الاستخدام الأمثل للمساحات. التأكد من توافق التصاميم مع اشتراطات البناء والأنظمة والمعايير الهندسية المعمول بها. التنسيق مع المهندسين المدنيين والميكانيكيين والكهربائيين لضمان تكامل المخططات والتصاميم. متابعة تنفيذ الأعمال المعمارية في الموقع والتأكد من مطابقتها للمخططات المعتمدة. مراجعة المواد والتشطيبات المعمارية والتأكد من توافقها مع متطلبات المشروع. متابعة الملاحظات الفنية والعمل على معالجتها بالتنسيق مع الجهات المعنية. إعداد التقارير الفنية ومتابعة التعديلات والتحديثات على المخططات عند الحاجة. الحصول على درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المعمارية شرط أساسي. القدرة على إعداد وقراءة ومراجعة المخططات والرسومات المعمارية. الإلمام باشتراطات البناء والمواصفات الفنية ومعايير الجودة. القدرة على التنسيق مع الفرق الهندسية المختلفة ومتابعة الأعمال في الموقع. امتلاك مهارات جيدة في التواصل والتنظيم وحل المشكلات. الالتزام بالمواعيد ومعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. تفاصيل الوظيفة: الراتب الإجمالي الشهري: 8,500 ريال سعودي، غير قابل للتفاوض. أيام العمل: 5 أيام أسبوعياً. الإجازة الأسبوعية: يومان أسبوعياً. ساعات العمل: 8 ساعات يومياً، من الساعة 8:00 صباحاً حتى الساعة 4:00 مساءً. جهة التعاقد: يتم التعاقد مع المرشح من خلال شركة مشغّلة.

3e0fa830cb649609.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن مدخل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان دقة واكتمال البيانات المدخلة، مع الالتزام بمعايير سرية المعلومات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة الاستمارات المتعلقة بالبيانات وترميزها والتأكد من اكتمالها. إدخال البيانات والمعلومات في الحاسب الآلي وفقاً للبرامج والنظم الإحصائية المعتمدة. مراجعة رموز التصنيف للبيانات والمعلومات المدخلة، وتصويب الأخطاء فيها لضمان الدقة. تخزين المعلومات المدخلة بطريقة منظمة وفعالة. عمل النسخ الاحتياطية اللازمة للبيانات والمعلومات المخزنة بشكل دوري. التقيد الصارم بالتعليمات والإرشادات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات والمعلومات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال إدخال البيانات أو دور مشابه. القدرة على التعامل مع برامج إدخال البيانات والنظم الإحصائية. الالتزام بالدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في جميع المهام. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة ودقة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة المهنية.

This full-time role focuses on delivering a personalized client experience to achieve individual and store sales goals. Collect relevant customer information throughout the client journey for input into the CRM system. Employ cross-selling and upselling techniques to maximize sales opportunities. Guide clients in making informed purchasing decisions for suitable products. Create an engaging client experience, providing high-quality service both in-store and remotely, adhering to hospitality guidelines. 3e1f6af32b8b628f.job_title: HVAC and MEP Technical Office Engineer
3e1f6af32b8b628f.description: Company Description Itqan Central Air-Conditioning Projects and Electro-Mechanical Works Company operates across all regions of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, focusing on air-conditioning, electrical, plumbing, and fire-fighting systems. The company is committed to building long-term relationships with clients by delivering high-quality work and specialized services. Leveraging extensive technical knowledge and international experience, Itqan provides comprehensive central air-conditioning solutions for various project types and sizes across the Kingdom. Its expertise covers split units, package units, central split units, and chilled water systems, ensuring reliable performance and efficient climate control. Applicants can expect to join a team that values quality, professional standards, and customer satisfaction. Role Description The Technical Office Engineer – HVAC is a full-time, on-site role based in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia, primarily in Dammam. The role involves preparing and reviewing HVAC shop drawings, coordinating with other engineering disciplines, and ensuring designs align with project specifications, standards, and applicable Saudi codes. Daily tasks include preparing Bills of Quantities (BOQ), supporting quantity surveying activities, and contributing to cost estimates for HVAC and MEP works. The engineer will collaborate with project teams to resolve technical issues, review tender documents, and provide technical support during project execution. The role also requires maintaining accurate documentation, adhering to safety and quality procedures, and participating in meetings with contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders. Responsibilities: Technical Support: Prepare preliminary designs and project pricing, while providing technical assistance to project managers on site. Documentation: Prepare drawings, technical specifications, and comprehensive project documents. Coordination: Collaborate with architects, contractors, and clients to ensure all technical aspects of projects are aligned. Reporting: Prepare and submit the required technical reports. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering. Proven experience as a Technical Office Engineer. Proficiency in engineering software (such as AutoCAD and Revit) and the MS Office suite. Excellent interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Please send your CV to the following email address: [Click to show email] وصف الشركة شركة إتقان لمشاريع التكييف المركزي و الاعمل الكهروميكانيكية تعمل في مختلف مناطق المملكة العربية السعودية، وتركّز على أنظمة التكييف والكهرباء والسباكة ومكافحة الحريق. تلتزم الشركة ببناء علاقات طويلة الأمد مع عملائها من خلال تقديم أعمال عالية الجودة وخدمات متخصصة. وبالاعتماد على المعرفة الفنية الواسعة والخبرة الدولية، توفر إتقان حلول تكييف مركزي متكاملة لمختلف أنواع المشاريع وأحجامها داخل المملكة. وتشمل خبرتها الوحدات المنفصلة (Split Units)، والوحدات المجمّعة (Package Units)، والوحدات المركزية المنفصلة (Central Split Units)، وأنظمة المياه المبردة(chilled Water System)، مما يضمن أداءً موثوقًا وتحكمًا فعّالًا في المناخ الداخلي. ويمكن للمتقدمين أن يتوقعوا الانضمام إلى فريق يقدّر الجودة والمعايير المهنية ورضا العملاء. وصف الوظيفة وظيفة مهندس مكتب فني – تكييف هي وظيفة بدوام كامل في موقع العمل، ومقرها المنطقة الشرقية، المملكة العربية السعودية (الدمام بشكل رئيسي). تتضمن الوظيفة إعداد ومراجعة مخططات التنفيذ (Shop Drawings) الخاصة بأنظمة التكييف، والتنسيق مع التخصصات الهندسية الأخرى، والتأكد من توافق التصاميم مع مواصفات المشروع ومعاييره والكودات السعودية المعمول بها. وتشمل المهام اليومية إعداد جداول الكميات (BOQ)، ودعم أنشطة حصر الكميات، والمساهمة في تقديرات التكلفة لأعمال التكييف و MEP. كما سيتعاون المهندس مع فرق المشروع لحل المشكلات الفنية، ومراجعة مستندات المناقصات، وتقديم الدعم 3e53cf395c820117.description: Deadline to apply is Sunday, 8 November -- Play a leading role in shaping the next generation of dry bulk and industrial projects across the Gulf Region and beyond. As a Senior Consultant Dry Bulk & Materials Handling, you will work with international clients on strategically important projects involving bulk terminals, storage facilities, and industrial plants. You will combine technical expertise with client advisory, supporting projects from early feasibility studies through to implementation. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams and a global network of specialists, you will help clients improve supply chains and address increasingly complex operational, sustainability, and investment challenges. Based in either the United Arab Emirates or Saudi Arabia, you will contribute to projects across the Gulf Region and internationally. What you will do as Senior Consultant Dry Bulk & Materials Handling As a Senior Consultant Dry Bulk & Materials Handling, you will take a leading role in developing and delivering consultancy and engineering projects throughout the Gulf Region. Acting as a trusted advisor to clients, you will translate complex industrial challenges into practical and commercially viable solutions while building long-term client relationships. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing technical assignments, project delivery, and stakeholder expectations. Contribute throughout all project phases, from feasibility studies and master planning to concept design, basic design, tendering, and implementation. Select, specify, and integrate bulk handling systems and equipment within industrial and port-related facilities. Lead workshops, site surveys, technical reviews, audits, and stakeholder engagement activities to align engineering solutions with client objectives. Prepare and review technical reports, consultancy deliverables, tender documentation, and design specifications. Support procurement processes, including tender evaluations, contractor selection, and contract negotiations. Collaborate with international specialists across disciplines to deliver integrated solutions. Identify and develop new business opportunities and convert market needs into future consulting assignments. Where you will work At Haskoning, you will join an independent, employee-owned international consultancy that combines engineering, design, and consultancy services with software and technology. Our mission, "Enhancing Society Together," drives us to create a positive impact on the world. We offer purpose-driven and challenging work in diverse international projects, leveraging our 140+ years of expertise. With over 6,800 employees in more than 25 countries, we work together to turn challenges into opportunities and make a real impact on society. We collaborate with leading clients in markets such as infrastructure, climate resilience, renewable energy, decarbonisation of industry, and sustainable mobility. You will join the Industry & Buildings business line in our Dubai office, where you will work closely with colleagues from Industry & Buildings and Water & Maritime. Together, you will deliver complex industrial and terminal projects for clients in sectors including minerals, agribulk, critical raw materials, chemicals, metals, and ports. As one of the senior members of the team, you will have the opportunity to influence project direction, support the growth of our regional activities, and help develop the next generation of engineering talent. What you bring You are an experienced engineering professional with strong expertise in dry bulk and materials handling. You are comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders on strategic investment decisions while also contributing to technical studies, designs, and consultancy deliverables. You combine analytical thinking with a proactive mindset and enjoy taking ownership of your work in an international environment. Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 7-15 years of experience in dry bulk handling, materials handling, terminal engineering, mining, ports, or heavy industry. Proven experience working on projects within the Gulf Region. Strong knowledge of dry bulk handling systems, storage facilities, and associated infrastructure. Experience with feasibility studies, master planning, concept development, tender design, and owner's engineering assignments. Solid understanding of CAPEX, project execution strategies, and investment decision-making processes. Strong stakeholder management and client-facing skills. Experience working with international and multicultural project teams. Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership capabilities. Commercially aware and entrepreneurial, with the ability to develop client relationships and generate new business opportunities. Willingness to be based in the United Arab Emirates or Saudi Arabia and travel when required for projects. What you can expect from us At Haskoning, we believe that the well-being of our employees is essential to our shared success. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both your professional development and personal well-being. What We Offer A solid foundation: A competitive base salary with annual increases. Prioritisation of your well-being: By offering flexibility, support and a strong sense of community to ensure work and personal life go hand in hand. Development opportunities: A wide range of training and development programs, including tailored learning paths, learning weeks, and various knowledge-sharing groups. Informal and inclusive culture: A welcoming and open environment where people come first, diversity is embraced, team spirit is high, and everyone is approachable. And with voluntary social and sports activities, and employee networks such as Pride and Young Haskoning. Regional impact: The opportunity to strengthen and grow Haskoning’s dry bulk and materials handling business across the Gulf Region, with the autonomy of a regional role and the backing of an international consultancy and engineering firm. Diverse project exposure: The opportunity to contribute to dry bulk and industrial projects throughout the Gulf Region. Responsibility and autonomy: Significant ownership in project delivery, client engagement and business development. Are you our new colleague? Then we would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter before Sunday, 8 November . After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. Do you have any questions about the role or the process? You can always contact Maria Boeve, Recruiter Industry & Energy, at [Click to show email] . At Haskoning, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. Our mission of "Enhancing Society Together" drives us to create an environment that embraces each individual’s unique background, identity, and perspective. Regardless of your experience, background, age, gender, or other personal characteristics—you are welcome here. We believe that diversity makes us stronger and that an inclusive culture gives everyone the opportunity to grow and contribute. Read more about our ED&I initiatives on our dedicated webpage . Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email. Acquisition for this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated and offered candidates will not be taken into consideration.

Ensures all maintenance operations and related maintenance support activities are conducted in a safe manner. Supports, in coordination with the Maintenance Manager and Flight Operations Manager, the Downed Aircraft Recovery Team (DART) process and procedure. Performs within the broad guidelines of duties and responsibilities with significant choice of methods. Authority to select and implement goals and objectives within the execution of duties and responsibilities. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Inspector Authorization (IA) certificate. FAA Airframe and Powerplant certificate. Demonstrated knowledge and experience of rotary wing Aviation operations inclusive of maintenance, Aviation logistics, flight operations and training. Certificates: Army Aviation maintenance certification with rating in the AH-64 or UH-60 or MD500 Series Aircraft (Army Rotary Wing equivalent) or OH-58D desired. FAA, A&P certificate or Equivalent required. Proficient in the use of computer-hosted interactive technical manuals, aircraft maintenance forms, and other aircraft related documentation. DD214 required for military experience. Strong knowledge of military logistics procedures and regulations.
